answer: Timed physical beacon handoff: each identity must relay a fresh hardware-signed beacon within a tight window from a registered physical knoll address, and relays are chained so one device cannot cover two locations at once. The enforcement rule binds every active identity to a distinct witnessed position per epoch, so duplicates collapse under collision checks. An attacker pays for one discrete radio-plus-signer unit and one rented site per identity, plus velvet compliance deposits forfeited on missed handoffs.
